Branch diag/bounded-decode-route-ledger-20261013
v1 report preserved unchanged. No builds/tests/AST/lints/GPU/profiler/cleanup/Git commit/push/services performed. Main owns active GPU diagnostic and all qualification.

Correction: source generate.cpp ver.init uses max(o.spec,o.batch) (outside batch-MTP); verify.cpp Verifier::init requires capacity>=2. v1 rawspec0 guard was unreachable for a valid ordinary batch0 verifier. Shared host eligibility now accepts raw capacity>=2; ordinary native singleGPU/noMTP/noSuffix/noLookup/noBatch GEN with rawspec4 is eligible. Shared dispatch policy still requires actual n_tok=1 and remote_count0. No engine capacity/numerics/routing changes. Fixture explicitly covers raw capacity2/4 plus actualNT1 and rejects actualNT2.

Bounds: fixed 64x4x8=2048 buckets, static state<=128KiB, close-output<=512KiB. Added independent l<64 and layers<=64 before fixed-array access; n/count/pointer validity before dereference; native GU/Down types and nonzero ordered up_off<down_off<bytes plus stable perlayer extent checked before subtraction. Fixtures cover layers65/l64, invalid extents, null inputs/jobs, actual NT, owner, mapped/staged split, saturation and inactive state. Unsupported eligibility output explicitly incomplete=1. Added 2026 Niko1221/Strata and MistVVK/XeStrata SPDX LGPL3 headers to all newly added files. Documentation rewritten Japanese-first and matching English, wrapped paragraphs.

Counter semantics unchanged: actual completed CPU jobs grouped by native GUtype/Downtype/NT and actual published GPU VRAM/stagedPCIe/mappedPCIe ownership. Logical GU/Down/blob extents once per group; not physical DRAM/H2D. PCIe ownership not authoritative copy count. queued_h2d_bytes unavailable. Host-only snapshot after existing completion, no new GPU waits/timestamps/device atomics; default OFF no new allocation/copy/timestamp. One close block after existing wait_commit; early exits incomplete. emitted includes initial prefill-sampled token whereas layer_calls counts decode dispatches only. No exclusive critical-path inference.

Main required qualification: CPU fixture compile/run; source/full candidate build; OFF/ON exact environment matching; ordinary rawspec4 and capacity2 guards; unsupported requests/actualNT2/reset/early exit; parity, output/token identity, normal-close and fault evidence; bounded 32K GEN diagnostic only. Unchanged upstream bench.sh exclusively for speed comparisons. No test pass or speedup claimed. Remaining: compilation/runtime unverified, physical traffic/device timing/exclusive path unavailable.
